text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I finished my work
and was about to leave Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Transitioning to "Reception"... Initiating directional search...
Deploying "Panorama."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Nn... A drop in intensity?
I cannot detect it...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's diffusing... amid the magnetic storm...
Could there be an issue with the antenna...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems fatigue from racing has caught up with Neo Universe.
It might be best to reconsider her schedule...
